  • Staff presented on the Mayor’s Fund update amounts, both agencies have

3.  25-54706  Recommendation to review and approve the Mayor’s Fund Standard operating
  procedures (SOP) verbiage updates.

  A motion was made by Voting Member Lie, seconded by Voting Member
  Wood, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  3  Lewis, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Member Stephen Woods joined the meeting at 2:22 p.m
  • Chair Lewis introduced the item for discussion, and staff provided an
  overview of the edits made, which included updates to the intake process
  and participant notifications.
  • Staff and members of the subcommittee discussed the intent of the Mayor’s
  Fund, member Lie requested appeals to be heard at the larger HSAC
  meeting, additional request were made to add under the eligibility
  requirements for applicants.

4.  25-54709  Recommendation to review and discuss the Mayor’s Fund grant application and

  A motion was made by Voting Member Wood, seconded by Voting Member
  Lie, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Lewis, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Members of the subcommittee requested a separate web page dedicated to
  the Mayor’s Fund be added under the Homeless Services Volunteer website,
  member Lie will work on creating new language for the website and

5.  25-54705  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the fundraising strategies for

  A motion was made by Voting Member Lie, seconded by Voting Member
  Wood, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  3  Lewis, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Members of the subcommittee discussed fundraising strategies, they would
  like to do another mailing campaign. Staff will look into the cost and provide
  updates at the next meeting.
  • The subcommittee would like to increase the Mayor’s Fund social media
  presence, staff will connect with appropriate team to discuss this further.
  • Staff provided updates on the airport and parking meter Mayor’s Fund
  donations, the team is waiting on updates from other departments. The
  subcommittee members inquired about adding collection pots during the
  Grand Prix event dedicated fo the Mayor’s Fund for donations.
